Q01: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM Customer
Q02: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM Customer GROUP BY Country ORDER BY customer_count DESC, Country LIMIT 5
Q03: SELECT BillingCountry AS Country, SUM(Total) AS total_revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 3
Q04: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.CustomerId) AS customer_count FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock'
Q05: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS customer_count FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 1
Q06: SELECT COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track WHERE Milliseconds > 300000
Q07: SELECT g.Name FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name HAVING COUNT(t.TrackId) > 100 ORDER BY g.Name
Q08: SELECT SUM(Total) AS total_revenue FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2013'
